name: @projexlight/sdk-parsing
summary: Multi-stage document parsing pipeline: ingest a binary (PDF / DOCX / scanned image) → OCR → layout analysis → structured field extraction (delegates to sdk-taxonomy) → human-review queue for low-confidence rows. Powers claims-intake, contract analysis, invoice processing, healthcare record digitization.

events.name: parsing.job.created.v1
events.description: Parsing job submitted; carries source blob_id + stages config.

events.name: parsing.stage.completed.v1
events.description: Pipeline stage finished (OCR / layout / extract); carries output ref + cost.

events.name: parsing.job.completed.v1
events.description: Full pipeline finished; carries extracted fields + per-field confidence.

events.name: parsing.review.assigned.v1
events.description: Low-confidence fields routed to human review queue.

events.name: parsing.review.resolved.v1
events.description: Reviewer corrected (or approved) extracted fields; feeds back into taxonomy training.

models.description: Per-job row: source_blob_id, stages, status, started_at, completed_at.
Per-stage row: kind (ocr/layout/extract), output_ref, duration_ms, cost.
Per-extracted-field row: name, value, confidence, source_bbox.

hooks.name: submitJob
hooks.description: Submit a parsing job; returns job_id.

hooks.name: resolveReview
hooks.description: Human reviewer corrects or approves a low-confidence field.

hooks.name: startWorker
hooks.description: Background worker — pulls submitted jobs + drives them through stages.

scenarios.title: Inbound claim PDF → structured fields
scenarios.when_to_use: Insurance claim arrives as PDF in sdk-media; submit a parsing job that runs OCR + layout + taxonomy extraction.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Job_id returned. Background worker drives stages; emits .stage.completed.v1 per stage + .job.completed.v1 at the end.

scenarios.title: Reactive: media.blob.ingested.v1 with kind=pdf auto-submits a parsing job
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant has 'auto-parse all PDFs' policy; reactive consumer submits jobs automatically on every PDF ingest.
scenarios.expected_outcome: PDF uploaded → parsed automatically. Structured fields available within minutes.

scenarios.title: Low-confidence field routes to human review
scenarios.when_to_use: Extraction confidence < PARSING_LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD; the field routes to a review queue + a human approves / corrects.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Field updated; emits .review.resolved.v1. Correction signal feeds back into sdk-taxonomy for the next training pass.

scenarios.title: Retry just the failed OCR stage on a job
scenarios.when_to_use: OCR failed (out-of-memory on a huge PDF); the worker auto-retries with smaller chunking. If still failing, the job is parked with a human-resolvable error.
scenarios.example_code:
// stage worker handles retry; getJobStatus surfaces:
{ status: 'partial-failure', failed_stage: 'ocr', retries: 3, parked_for_review: true }
scenarios.expected_outcome: Job state visible; ops can intervene if needed. Audit chain has the full retry trail.

scenarios.title: New taxonomy version → re-run extractions
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on taxonomy.version.published.v1 — for tenants opted into auto-migrate, re-run the extract stage on recent jobs with the new version.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Recent jobs re-extracted on the new taxonomy. Old extractions retained alongside new for diff review.

compliance_posture.notes: Every stage pinned to its provider + model version so a regulator can replay. Source blob retained for the full retention period; extracted fields keep source_bbox so any value traces back to its pixel location for HIPAA + claims-adjudication review.
